title: Buffalo Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Mix chickpeas with chilli sauce, smoked paprika and garlic granules; spray with cooking spray.
Line a baking tray with parchment; spread chickpeas in a single layer; spray again; sprinkle with salt.
Remove from oven; leave 10 minutes to crisp up further.
notes: Keeps in an airtight container for up to 4 days. Also works scattered over salad or soup as a crouton alternative.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
